capabilities: Track ideas through a hatch-to-project lifecycle on a sidebar kanban
Schedule SM-2 spaced-repetition reviews of notes
Classify, summarize, and archive inbox notes with an LLM
Answer questions against the vault wiki and detect contradictions, orphan pages, and stale claims
Manage daily notes on a calendar, generate weekly reports, and archive old journals monthly
extras: The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Core features (kanban, calendar, review, reports, archival) work offline; only LLM features need configuration. API keys are stored locally. Mobile is supported via responsive layout and long-press menus.
motivation: The author built it for the experience of opening Obsidian and spending 30 minutes deciding what to work on instead of doing anything.
problem: Opening Obsidian without knowing what to do next, with ideas stuck in drafts, an unsorted inbox, and notes that are written once and forgotten.
